Preflight Demo Program
DOC-0005 2026-10-07
What a Closure Note Must Say
POLICY
Effective date: 2026-10-07
Custodian: PERSON-0023, TEAM-0005
Scope: Closing paperwork for the fictional issue queue.
_ Write a closure note that identifies the original coordination question, the
administrative disposition, the references supporting that disposition, the
recorder, and the date. Explain where a later reader can find the underlying
paperwork. A bare statement that the matter is finished does not provide a
traceable account.
Distinguish the issue disposition from task entries. A task entry alone does
not establish that an issue should be closed. If the note cites a task, explain
its documentary relevance rather than copying its label as the entire
explanation.
Index attachments before filing the note. Put the attachment heading and
filing location on the cover sheet, and retain the sequence in which the
papers were received. A missing attachment becomes a request to the
records clerk with an owner and a due date.
State any continuing administrative obligation and the role that will carry it.
If the obligation belongs in another queue, retain the destination reference
with the note. Do not hide a future records request inside a concluding
sentence.
~ Keep this note about paperwork only. It must contain no physical work
directions or judgment about an aircraft. ISSUE-0101, TASK-0268, and
TASK-0970 provide locating references for the hydraulics filing example.
Revision note: This edition adds the attachment index and a separate line for
continuing administrative obligations.
D. Worker 0023
Demo Worker 0023, Demo Team 05
